name: omnijev/flide
title: Independent RTX 4090 test of Flide: about 6x over vLLM on many-questions-per-text decision workloads, 1.6x to 3.6x with one question
summary: A hands-on test of the Flide inference engine (paper claims up to 9.5x) found 3.8x from forking alone and about 6x against the tester's own vLLM setup with 8 questions per email, shrinking to 1.6x to 3.6x with one question. Install and first start were quick, the tester's RTX 4060 laptop did not work, and the 0.8B model had weak recall on the spam task.
